# Scratch: @neondatabase/auth-ui type inspection
<!-- Generated by Task 3 — consumed by Task 4, not committed -->

## Package entry points

- Main types: `apps/web/node_modules/@neondatabase/auth-ui/dist/index.d.mts`
- The Neon package re-exports everything from `@daveyplate/better-auth-ui@3.3.9`
- `AuthViewPath`, `AuthView`, `AuthUIProviderProps` all originate in `@daveyplate/better-auth-ui`

---

## Item 1 — `AuthView` prop name for the route path

`AuthViewProps` declares **both**:
```ts
interface AuthViewProps {
  path?: string;      // ← generic string fallback
  pathname?: string;  // ← also available
  view?: keyof AuthViewPaths;  // ← key-based alternative (e.g. "SIGN_IN")
  // ...
}
```
The reference code uses `path={path as AuthViewPath}`. That is **wrong** — `path` is typed as `string`, not `AuthViewPath`. The `view` prop is the typed alternative (`view?: keyof AuthViewPaths`).

**Correct usage (two options):**
```tsx
// Option A — use `view` prop with proper type
<AuthView view={view as keyof AuthViewPaths} />

// Option B — use `path` prop with a plain string (no need for AuthViewPath cast)
<AuthView path={pathname} />
```

---

## Item 2 — Exported TypeScript type name for path/pathname values

`AuthViewPath` IS exported and IS the correct type name:
```ts
type AuthViewPath = keyof AuthViewPaths;
// i.e. "CALLBACK" | "EMAIL_OTP" | "FORGOT_PASSWORD" | "MAGIC_LINK" |
//      "RECOVER_ACCOUNT" | "RESET_PASSWORD" | "SIGN_IN" | "SIGN_OUT" |
//      "SIGN_UP" | "TWO_FACTOR" | "ACCEPT_INVITATION"
```

Import path:
```ts
import type { AuthViewPath } from "@neondatabase/auth-ui";
```

**Note:** `AuthViewPath` is the `view` prop type, NOT the `path` prop type.
- `path?: string` — plain string (e.g. `"/auth/sign-in"`)
- `view?: AuthViewPath` — enum key (e.g. `"SIGN_IN"`)

---

## Item 3 — `NeonAuthUIProvider` props

`NeonAuthUIProvider` is defined in `@neondatabase/auth-ui` as:
```ts
type NeonAuthUIProviderProps<T extends NeonAuthAdapter> =
  Omit<AuthUIProviderProps, 'authClient'> & {
    authClient: NeonAuthPublicApi<T>;
    className?: string;
    defaultTheme?: 'light' | 'dark' | 'system';
  };
```

It passes all remaining props (via `...props`) to `AuthUIProvider`, which comes from
`@daveyplate/better-auth-ui`. The full `AuthUIContextType` (resolved from `AuthUIProviderProps`)
contains:

| Prop | Declared type | Notes |
|------|---------------|-------|
| `authClient` | `NeonAuthPublicApi<T>` | Neon-specific override |
| `navigate` | `(href: string) => void` | **Exactly one-arg** |
| `replace` | `(href: string) => void` | **Exactly one-arg** |
| `onSessionChange` | `() => void \| Promise<void>` | Called when session changes |
| `Link` | `ComponentType<{ href: string; className?: string; children: ReactNode }>` | Custom link component |
| `magicLink` | `boolean \| undefined` (optional) | **IS a plain boolean prop** |

All four routing props (`navigate`, `replace`, `onSessionChange`, `Link`) are in
`AuthUIContextType`, which is spread into `AuthUIProviderProps` via:
```ts
type AuthUIProviderProps = { ... } & Partial<Omit<AuthUIContextType, ...>>;
```

---

## Item 4 — Magic link API

`magicLink` IS a plain boolean prop on `AuthUIProviderProps` / `AuthUIContextType`:
```ts
/**
 * Enable or disable Magic Link support
 * @default false
 */
magicLink?: boolean;
```

The reference code `magicLink` (bare attribute) is valid JSX shorthand for `magicLink={true}`.
**No change needed.**

---

## Item 5 — Can `router.push` be passed directly as `navigate`?

The `navigate` type is strictly `(href: string) => void`.

Next.js `router.push` signature (from `next/navigation`):
```ts
push(href: string, options?: NavigateOptions): void
```

TypeScript **will reject** `navigate={router.push}` because the function signatures are
incompatible in the strict direction — `router.push` accepts an optional second argument
which makes it a wider type than `(href: string) => void`.

**A wrapper arrow IS required:**
```tsx
navigate={(href) => router.push(href)}
replace={(href) => router.replace(href)}
```

Same applies to `replace`.

For `onSessionChange`, the declared type is `() => void | Promise<void>`.
`router.refresh` signature is `() => void` — **direct assignment is safe**, no wrapper needed.

---

## Correct import statement for Task 4

```ts
import "@neondatabase/auth-ui/css";
import { AuthView, NeonAuthUIProvider } from "@neondatabase/auth-ui";
import type { AuthViewPath } from "@neondatabase/auth-ui";
```

---

## Correct JSX shape for Task 4

```tsx
<NeonAuthUIProvider
  authClient={authClient}
  navigate={(href) => router.push(href)}      // wrapper required — router.push has 2nd arg
  replace={(href) => router.replace(href)}    // wrapper required — same reason
  onSessionChange={router.refresh}            // direct OK — () => void matches
  Link={Link}
  magicLink                                   // boolean shorthand — correct
>
  {/*
    Use `view` prop (AuthViewPath enum key) for typed routing, OR
    use `path` prop (plain string pathname) for path-based routing.
    The reference code `path={path as AuthViewPath}` is misleading —
    `path` is typed as `string`, the cast is harmless but `view` is cleaner.
  */}
  <AuthView path={pathname} />
  {/* — OR — */}
  <AuthView view={view as AuthViewPath} />
</NeonAuthUIProvider>
```

---

## Deviations from reference code

| Reference assumption | Reality | Action for Task 4 |
|---|---|---|
| `navigate={router.push}` direct | Rejected — `router.push` has optional 2nd arg | Use `navigate={(href) => router.push(href)}` |
| `replace={router.replace}` direct | Rejected — same reason | Use `replace={(href) => router.replace(href)}` |
| `<AuthView path={path as AuthViewPath} />` | `path` is `string`, cast is misleading; `AuthViewPath` is for `view` prop | Use `path={pathname}` (string) OR `view={view as AuthViewPath}` |
| `magicLink` boolean shorthand | Confirmed correct — `magicLink?: boolean` | No change |
| `onSessionChange={router.refresh}` | Confirmed correct — `() => void` matches | No change |
| `Link={Link}` | Confirmed correct — `ComponentType<{href, className?, children}>` | No change |
